column1: # Rows db.tchar.* (line RG-KB item 9(b)): databases whose stored definition-line titles hold bytes outside ' ' to '~' (tests/db_search/tchar, make_tchar.py; README.md there, section "Titles with bytes outside the visible ASCII range"), the five programs: in outfmt 8, 9, 11 and 12 NCBI reads a reported subject's definition line only where it makes the Seq-aligns of its query batch (GetSeqIDs, through the volume's cache of 256 header records by OID), and posts Error: (803.7) [<program>] Blast-def-line-set.E.title / Bad char [0x..] in string at byte N / the title for each such byte at each read that the cache does not answer (N the position after the whole title in its record; the bytes before it already '#'); rows .mb.* split the queries into batches (BATCH_SIZE), .big.* hold OIDs 256 apart (one cache slot) read in both orders and with a clean record of the slot between, .bigal.* an alias of two volumes of 300 (a cache per volume, by the volume's OIDs), .alias.* a second volume, .dmg.* a header NCBI cannot read after a post in one batch (the posts before NCBI's error, in any format), .ps.* parsed Seq-ids, .u8.* a UTF8String title in an earlier batch, .x.* titles of 300 and 1,100 bytes and a NUL; rows of item 9b-2 (outfmt 0, 3, 5, 6, 7, 10, 13 to 18, and 8 with PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=2147483647): each batch's prefetch loads each subject once, in Seq-id handle order (OID 0 last), unless NCBI's cache of 10 released blobs still holds it from a batch before (a load reads the header through the cache, then registers the ids of the header its Bioseq holds, which posts unless a second volume wrote it again), each row whose fields read the definition line (sall* ids, taxonomy, stitle, salltitles) posts again, and so do the pairwise reports' two reads at each description line (with -html the links' registry between them) and one at each alignment heading, BLAST XML's, XML2's and JSON's one read at each Hit, after the loads and before its taxonomy lookups (rows .5, .13 to .16, .mb.5, .mb.16), and the organism report's two at each Seq-align, the second at its first shown definition line before its taxonomy lookup (rows .18, .18h); rows .keep.mb.* (tc_qkeep: OID 2, eleven clean subjects, OID 2 again, a batch each): BLAST XML keeps its scope across the batches, so OID 2 is not loaded again (.keep.mb.5), where XML2 and the tables reset it after each batch and the release of the eleven pushes OID 2 out of the cache of 10 (.keep.mb.16, .keep.mb.6t); the losat-rejection rows are the prefetch off and parsed Seq-ids with the prefetch (LOSAT's refusal, check_reported_title).
